# enV

> enV brings together practical tools for calculations, conversions, creative work, development, media, files, business tasks and everyday planning across Web, Android and iOS.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://envtools.store/): Platform overview and tool discovery.
- [All tools](https://envtools.store/tools): Search and browse available tools.
- [Blogs and guides](https://envtools.store/blog): Product articles and detailed tool documentation.
- [About enV](https://envtools.store/about): Platform and company information.
- [Pricing](https://envtools.store/pricing): Usage and token-pricing explanations.
- [Help center](https://envtools.store/help): Tool use, troubleshooting, and support answers.
- [Contact](https://envtools.store/contact): Official product and company contact routes.
- [Privacy](https://envtools.store/privacy): Data handling and feature processing information.
- [Terms](https://envtools.store/terms): Terms for using enV across platforms.
- [Responsible use](https://envtools.store/responsible-use): Safe and lawful use guidance.
- [Disclaimer](https://envtools.store/disclaimer): Output verification and decision-use limits.
- [Android](https://envtools.store/platform/android): Native Android and Web tool handoff information.
- [iOS](https://envtools.store/platform/ios): Native iOS and Web tool handoff information.
- [Token guide](https://envtools.store/token-guide): Catalogue token estimates and billing classifications.
- [Public tool discussions](https://envtools.store/community): Public comments and replies contributed by enV users.

## Public tool categories
- [Accessibility](https://envtools.store/tools/accessibility): Review websites, documents and interfaces for common accessibility issues, then use practical checks to improve readability and access.
- [AI micro-tools](https://envtools.store/tools/ai): Draft and refine short text such as titles, bios, captions and prompts. Each tool explains whether it uses local templates or optional AI assistance.
- [Audio](https://envtools.store/tools/audio): Work with audio through tools for conversion, editing, analysis, recording, stem workflows and practice. Processing requirements depend on the selected tool.
- [Business](https://envtools.store/tools/business): Prepare business documents and work with common business figures, including invoices, receipts, quotations, pricing, cash flow and inventory.
- [Calculators](https://envtools.store/tools/calculators): Solve everyday maths problems and estimate financial, geometric, construction and science values using the inputs and assumptions shown by each calculator.
- [Career](https://envtools.store/tools/career): Prepare CVs, resumes, cover letters and portfolios, practise interview questions, and review job-search or salary information.
- [Celebrations](https://envtools.store/tools/celebrations): Create invitations, cards, countdowns and shareable pages for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations and other occasions.
- [Communication](https://envtools.store/tools/communication): Write and organize messages, emails, meeting materials, signatures, invitations and other everyday communications.
- [Creators & music](https://envtools.store/tools/creators): Plan creator content and review tools for platform earnings estimates, thumbnails, captions, audio tempo and royalty calculations.
- [Date & time](https://envtools.store/tools/datetime): Calculate ages and durations, convert timestamps, compare time zones, and work with countdowns and calendar-related values.
- [Design](https://envtools.store/tools/design): Create and inspect colors, palettes, gradients, CSS values and visual styles, with supporting checks for contrast and interface design.
- [Developer](https://envtools.store/tools/developer): Format, validate, encode, decode and inspect common data formats, web standards and developer values. Check each tool's guidance before using results in production.
- [E-commerce](https://envtools.store/tools/ecommerce): Prepare product and catalogue data, review prices and discounts, and work with inventory, orders, shipping and store operations.
- [Education](https://envtools.store/tools/education): Calculate grades and study-related values, organize study time, and work with common academic planning tasks.
- [Events](https://envtools.store/tools/events): Prepare event invitations, RSVP pages, countdowns, schedules, agendas and ticket or check-in mockups for different kinds of events.
- [Files](https://envtools.store/tools/files): Convert, inspect, organize, compare, search and archive files. Available formats and processing methods vary by tool.
- [Fitness & health](https://envtools.store/tools/fitness): Calculate common fitness measurements and training values, including body-mass estimates, nutrition targets and activity pace. Results are estimates, not medical advice.
- [Gaming](https://envtools.store/tools/gaming): Create game characters and scenarios, generate random choices, organize tournaments and review scores or streaming-related values.
- [Image](https://envtools.store/tools/image): Resize, compress, convert, crop, annotate and adjust images using the operations available in each image tool.
- [Interactive Experiences](https://envtools.store/tools/interactive): Create interactive pages, quizzes, reveals, invitations and other shareable experiences using the available layouts and controls.
- [Marketing](https://envtools.store/tools/marketing): Plan campaigns and content, prepare marketing copy, review pricing and organize common marketing workflows.
- [PDF & documents](https://envtools.store/tools/pdf): Work with PDF files and supported document formats. Merge, split, reorder, rotate, extract or convert content using the operations each tool provides.
- [Personal Utilities](https://envtools.store/tools/personal): Organize personal tasks, plan routines and goals, compare everyday choices, and prepare for common life events.
- [Photography](https://envtools.store/tools/photography): Work with photo dimensions, print sizes, exposure, camera settings and image planning using the controls available in each tool.
- [Productivity](https://envtools.store/tools/productivity): Manage time with timers and countdowns, organize focus sessions, and calculate values used in everyday planning.
- [QR & barcodes](https://envtools.store/tools/qr): Create QR codes and supported barcodes for links, Wi-Fi details, contact cards and product identifiers, or read codes with the scanning tools available.
- [Random & fun](https://envtools.store/tools/random): Generate random names, numbers, choices, prompts and lists, or use wheels and dice for simple selection activities.
- [Relationships & Social](https://envtools.store/tools/relationships): Create conversation prompts, messages, quizzes and light interactive experiences for friends, couples and social occasions.
- [Security & privacy](https://envtools.store/tools/security): Use defensive tools to generate passwords, inspect password strength, calculate hashes and review or remove supported file metadata.
- [SEO & web](https://envtools.store/tools/seo): Prepare and inspect common website search metadata, social tags, structured data, robots rules and sitemap files.
- [Social media](https://envtools.store/tools/social): Prepare social media images and draft captions, bios, hashtags and profile or post content for supported platforms.
- [Streaming](https://envtools.store/tools/streaming): Plan livestreams and audio or video delivery with tools for bitrate, resolution, timing, titles, overlays and creator estimates.
- [Test data](https://envtools.store/tools/testdata): Create clearly fictional sample records and structured payloads for testing applications, forms, APIs and data workflows.
- [Text](https://envtools.store/tools/text): Count, clean, sort, compare and transform text, including case changes and common formatting operations.
- [Unit converters](https://envtools.store/tools/converters): Convert measurements across common categories such as length, mass, area, volume, temperature, speed, time and data storage.
- [Video](https://envtools.store/tools/video): Calculate video dimensions, aspect ratios, frame rates, bitrates and estimated file sizes using the values and options shown by each tool.
- [Web & network](https://envtools.store/tools/network): Inspect and calculate common network and web values, including IP addresses, subnets, CIDR ranges, URLs and HTTP headers.
- [Web Design](https://envtools.store/tools/webdesign): Build and review web interface elements, including CSS, layouts, typography scales, responsive structures and design tokens.

- [A privacy-first approach to everyday online tools](https://envtools.store/blog/a-more-private-way-to-use-online-tools): How enV aims to make processing choices clear, favor on-device work where practical, and set accurate expectations when a feature depends on a server or external provider.
- [Understanding enV tokens, estimates, and charges](https://envtools.store/blog/how-env-tokens-are-designed-to-work): An accessible overview of fractional accounting, task-based costs, and the safeguards needed before token pricing can be treated as a live quote.

- [A large toolkit with a simpler user experience](https://envtools.store/blog/designing-tools-that-feel-simple): How consistent navigation, focused one-step utilities, and deeper workspaces can help enV serve a broad range of tasks without overwhelming people.

## Documentation and discovery
- Each available tool has a detailed guide at /blog/tool-{tool-id}.
- The XML sitemap lists canonical public tool pages, categories, guides, and articles: https://envtools.store/sitemap.xml
- The robots policy is available at https://envtools.store/robots.txt

## Accuracy
- Tool availability and processing paths are described on each tool page and its guide.
- Do not assume a tool is available based only on its name; check its live page and status.
- Product descriptions should be quoted with their page URL and checked against the current implementation.
